title: Herbed Cannabis Grilled Cheese with Caramelized Onions
h1: Herbed Cannabis Grilled Cheese, Dosed Through the Onions
metaDescription: A three-cheese grilled cheese with herby caramelized onions finished in cannabutter, easy per-sandwich dose math, and a low-heat method that helps protect potency.
excerpt: Three melty cheeses on brioche, with herby onions that carry the cannabutter. Split the onions four ways and every sandwich gets an even dose.
keyTakeaways: The cannabutter goes into the caramelized onions, which you split into four equal portions.
Divide the THC in the cannabutter by four for your per-sandwich estimate.
Medium-low heat keeps the butter from scorching and helps protect its potency.
Sandwiches are best fresh; leftover onions keep 3 to 4 days in a labeled container.
body:
This cannabis grilled cheese stacks white cheddar, Gruyère and Muenster on brioche with jammy onions cooked in cannabutter, thyme and rosemary. The onions carry the whole dose, so splitting them four ways gives every sandwich the same amount.

## Dosing a cannabis grilled cheese: keep the heat low

Divide the THC in your cannabutter by four. With butter estimated at 28 mg per tablespoon, 1 tablespoon gives about 7 mg per sandwich at most. Scrape all the butter from the pan into the onions before you portion them.

Butter's milk solids scorch at high heat, and long, hot cooking can break THC down, so the cannabutter joins the onions only for the last stretch, on low. Try half a sandwich first and wait 2 hours.

## Ingredients and method

Cook sliced onions slowly in olive oil until golden, then add the cannabutter, herbs and a pinch of brown sugar and cook until deep amber. Butter the outside of the brioche (or use mayo), layer the cheeses and these infused caramelized onions, and griddle over medium-low until melted. Our [cannabutter recipe](/blog/canna-butter-recipe/) covers the infusion, and you can order flower ahead for curbside pickup from [your local store](/shop/).

## Storage and labeling

A cannabutter grilled cheese is best eaten fresh. Refrigerate leftover onions in a sealed container labeled with the date and dose, and use them within 3 to 4 days. Keep them away from kids and pets; poison control is 1-800-222-1222.

## Pairings and a variation

Serve with tomato soup and crisp pickles. For a different dose point, keep the onions plain and finish each sandwich with a brush of melted cannabutter or a measured drizzle of [canna-honey](/blog/canna-honey/), not both. More cravings? Read about [the munchies](/blog/cannabis-tasting-what-are-munchies/) or try our [hot honey pizza](/blog/hot-honey-pizza/).

For adults 21 and older. Enjoy it responsibly.

faq.q: How do I keep cannabutter from burning?
faq.a: Keep the burner at medium-low or lower and add the cannabutter late, once the onions have softened. If the butter browns fast or starts to smoke, pull the pan off the heat for a minute. A heavy skillet holds steadier heat than a thin one.

faq.q: Can I make the onions ahead?
faq.a: Yes. Cook and portion them up to 3 days ahead and refrigerate them in a labeled container. Before building the sandwiches, warm each portion gently in the skillet, or let it come to room temperature so the cheese melts evenly around it.

The trio in this recipe works well: Gruyère brings nutty depth, Muenster melts silky and white cheddar adds tang. Fontina, Havarti and young Gouda melt well too. Grate the firmer cheeses so they melt before the bread gets too dark.

ingredients: 1 tablespoon cannabutter (or the amount your dose math calls for)
2 tablespoons softened butter or mayonnaise, for the bread
steps: Heat the olive oil in a wide skillet over medium-low. Add the onions and a pinch of salt and cook, stirring every few minutes, until soft and light golden, about 25 minutes. Add a splash of water if they stick.
Turn the heat to low. Add the cannabutter, thyme, rosemary and brown sugar and cook gently, stirring, until deep amber, 10 to 15 minutes. Don't let the butter smoke.
Scrape the onions and every bit of butter into a bowl, stir well and divide into four equal portions.
Heat the oven to 200°F. Spread butter or mayo on one side of each bread slice.
Set four slices buttered side down in a skillet over medium-low. Layer Gruyère, a slice of Muenster, one onion portion and cheddar on each, then top with the remaining bread, buttered side up.
Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, covering the pan briefly, until golden and melted. Keep finished sandwiches warm on a rack in the oven.
recipe.dosingNote: Think of this as an estimate. Example: 1 tablespoon of cannabutter at about 28 mg ÷ 4 sandwiches ≈ 7 mg per sandwich at most. Your real number depends on how potent the flower in your butter was and on how much THC the decarb and infusion lost, so it's likely lower. Start with half a sandwich and wait at least 2 hours before eating more. Label leftover onions as infused, and keep everything away from children and pets.

review.summary: 14 claims checked: 13 ok, 1 fixed (0 wrong, 0 unsupported, 1 overstated). 'Protects potency' (meta description and takeaway) is now 'helps protect': low heat and a short time on the burner cut THC loss but do not rule it out.

claims.claim: Dose math: 1 tablespoon of cannabutter at about 28 mg / 4 sandwiches = about 7 mg per sandwich at most (body, dosing note)
claims.source: arithmetic on an example potency the text labels as an example

claims.claim: Butter's milk solids scorch at high heat
claims.source: https://www.foodnetwork.com/how-to/packages/food-network-essentials/how-to-prevent-butter-from-burning (WebFetch): 'Butter's natural smoke point is around 350 degrees Fahrenheit.'; milk solids 'are very susceptible to burning'

claims.claim: Long, hot cooking can break THC down, so the cannabutter goes in last, on low
claims.source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5549281/ (Wang 2016, full text via Europe PMC): 'Maximum formation of Δ9-THC was observed in ∼5–10 min at 145°C followed by a significant loss at longer times possibly due to evaporation of Δ9-THC'; 'Δ9-THC itself readily oxidizes to cannabinol (CBN) with oxygen and light during the decarboxylation process'

claims.claim: Medium-low heat 'protects' the butter's potency (takeaway); 'a low-heat method that protects potency' (meta description)
claims.fix: both now say 'helps protect': lower heat and a shorter time reduce THC loss, but the cited work shows loss with time at heat, so no method fully protects it
claims.source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5549281/ (loss at longer times; 'the conversion of the acid to Δ9-THC was never perfectly complete without loss or degradation of starting material')

claims.claim: Try half a sandwich first and wait (at least) 2 hours
claims.source: https://www.cdc.gov/cannabis/health-effects/poisoning.html (WebFetch): 'Take from 30 minutes to 2 hours to feel intoxicating effects.'

claims.claim: Leftover onions keep 3 to 4 days in the fridge; onions can be made up to 3 days ahead (storage, takeaway, FAQ)
claims.source: https://www.fsis.usda.gov/food-safety/safe-food-handling-and-preparation/food-safety-basics/leftovers-and-food-safety (WebSearch on fsis.usda.gov; WebFetch gets 403): 'Leftovers can be kept in the refrigerator for 3 to 4 days or frozen for 3 to 4 months.'; https://extension.illinois.edu/food-safety/leftovers (WebFetch): 'Use refrigerated leftover food within 3-4 days.'

claims.claim: Keep leftovers away from kids and pets; poison control is 1-800-222-1222
claims.source: https://www.cdc.gov/cannabis/health-effects/poisoning.html: 'poison control center at 1-800-222-1222'; 'out of the reach and sight of children and pets'

claims.claim: Onions: about 25 minutes on medium-low to soft and light golden, then 10 to 15 minutes on low with the butter and sugar to deep amber
claims.source: https://www.simplyscratch.com/?p=52 (WebFetch): medium-low, 'after 40 to 45 minutes (total) the onions should be ultra tender and a deeply rich golden amber color'; the step's colour cue governs, and the brown sugar speeds browning

claims.claim: Gruyère, Muenster and white cheddar melt well; Fontina, Havarti and young Gouda melt well too
claims.source: https://www.tastingtable.com/2160093/absolute-best-cheeses-melting/ (WebFetch): its 13 melting cheeses include Fontina, Gruyère, Cheddar, Gouda, Muenster and Havarti; 'fontina melts smoothly'; Muenster's 'ability to melt extremely well'

claims.claim: A heavy skillet holds steadier heat than a thin one (FAQ)
Griddle 3 to 4 minutes per side over medium-low, covering briefly; hold finished sandwiches in a 200°F oven
claims.source: technique description; low heat with grated firm cheese is the melting advice on the Tasting Table page above

review.notes: Independent fact-check: Wang 2016 full text through Europe PMC; CDC, Food Network (butter smoke point), Tasting Table (melting cheeses) and Simply Scratch (onion timing) opened with WebFetch; the USDA FSIS leftovers page refuses WebFetch (403) and its 3-to-4-day line was confirmed by WebSearch on fsis.usda.gov, with Illinois Extension (opened) giving the same window. Dose math checked by hand. High Society appears once: order flower ahead for curbside pickup. Writer's notes: The brief's H1 "The Ultimate ..." was changed: "ultimate" is on the VOICE never-use list. The cannabutter goes in for the last 10 to 15 minutes on low (onions start in olive oil) to keep its time on the heat short, which serves the brief's low-heat, protect-potency angle. FAQ idea "How much cannabutter goes in each sandwich?" is answered in the dosing section. High Society appears once (order ahead, curbside pickup).
